crossRefs.note: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is Yahweh’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power…
It was broken in that day; and thus the poor of the flock that listened to me knew that it was Yahweh’s word.
The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the arrogance of men will be bowed down, and Yahweh alone will be exalted…
Yahweh of Armies has planned it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.
Yahweh says, “Don’t let the wise man glory in his wisdom. Don’t let the mighty man glory in his might. Don’t let the…
But let him who glories glory in this, that he has understanding, and knows me, that I am Yahweh who exercises loving…
At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise…
Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.
He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
In that same hour Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that…
The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?
Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.
For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;
But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God, and not from…

But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach,
Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and…
For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Yahweh also will save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of David’s house and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem not be magnified above Judah.
translations.bsb: The LORD will save the tents of Judah first, so that the glory of the house of David and of the people of Jerusalem may not be greater than that of Judah.
translations.kjv: The LORD also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves against Judah.
translations.asv: Jehovah also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem be not magnified above Judah.
